about_the_game:
You are Henry, a young man who finds himself thrust into an unknown world after a frightening accident. Despite waking at home shortly after, Henry discovers that the shift between realities would happen again... and again.



Henry's father explores every possibility to shield his son from this mysterious realm. However, after years of searching for answers, a gripping turn of events reveals to him powerful meaning and hope inherent to Henry's struggle. He begins to believe that Henry should embrace the ability given to him and delve even deeper into his world to uncover the truth within. In an effort to prevent this perspective from reaching Henry, an attempt is made on the father's life that tragically sends him into a coma.



  • Explore the secretive world that was made for Henry, long ago.
  • Craft tools and weapons in your struggle to survive.
  • Conquer dark and powerful creatures.
  • Fly over mountain tops with Henry’s Wing-Pack.
  • Find figments of Henry's dad scattered throughout his world.
  • Uncover the hidden meaning to the world beyond our realm.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600K or AMD Equivalent
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 or AMD RX 570
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 40 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 5600X or Intel Core i5-11600K
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3060 or AMD RX 6600-XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 40 GB available space

short_description: Embark on a powerful, heartfelt journey in Figments, a third-person action-adventure from VaporLock Labs. Immerse yourself in a hidden world, known only to Henry, where you can explore, craft, and fight to survive. Learn to conquer your deepest fears in this upcoming epic debut title.
